collection.title: BMW 1 Series Hatchback 2019 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 1 Series Hatchback 2019 - 2024 requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and a 17" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses a one of a kind BMW Specific Fit wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade available, just click on the Rear Blades tab below.
